title: Malicious code in calkyippie (npm)
description: The npm package 'calkyippie' version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that decodes and executes an obfuscated shell command at module load time. The package masquerades as a calculator utility, but it executes attacker-controlled commands via child_process.exec after decoding a hex-encoded payload from its own package.json. This payload fetches and runs a remote shell, enabling remote code execution on the host.
